We are seeking an energetic, self-motivated architect with a minimum of 2 years of professional experience and strong proficiency in Revit.
Our studio offers a collaborative, open, and multidisciplinary design environment. We work across a range of project types in a fast-paced setting, and we’re looking for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can work both independently and collaboratively and is eager to contribute throughout all phases of a project.
This is a full-time position with benefits.
Qualifications & Requirements
To Apply
Please submit your resume, work samples, and cover letter to [email protected].
In your cover letter, please include your availability and desired salary.
